title: KeywordMetric
description: Trending keyword / hashtag frequency metric published by Module 3 (stream-processor) to kol.metrics.keywords. Message key = keyword.

keyword.description: Normalized lowercase keyword or hashtag (without leading #)

is_hashtag.description: True if extracted from hashtags or #-prefixed token

velocity_per_min.description: Occurrences per minute within the sliding window

unique_kols.description: Number of distinct KOLs associated with this keyword in the current window

updated_at.description: UTC timestamp when this keyword snapshot was emitted
